newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA fuel oil bunkers slip, while gas oil rockets.
newsitem.headline: ARA fuel oil bunkers slip, while gas oil rockets.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers slipped on Tuesday with many other places steady, but European gas oil bunkers rocket, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers slipped after initial barge-inspired strength. Barges gained about $2 at the opening, but with only one trading house supporting the market. However, bunker sellers were reluctant to reduce their offers, leading to a wide bid-offer spread of $120/$123 fob.
The wide spread was testiment to the virtual lack of any buying interest. However, the lacklustre business came a day after the pre-holiday rush on Monday.
Hamburg prices were steady to $1 firmer at $127/$129 fob. Activity was also rather thin there.
Mediterranean fuel oil prices were broadly steady, although gas oil did jump up.
Spanish ports were calmed after healthy Monday enquiries. Las Palmas was rather short of gas oil.
Fujairah prices dipped by $2 to $112/$114 fob, although demand was not substantial.
